parameter: Carbon steel, hot surfaces above 400 degC, and stainless steel under insulation
remarks: TSA is the default under insulation on carbon steel and stainless steel at 60 to 595 degC, to avoid corrosion and chloride stress corrosion cracking under insulation
value_text: Thermally sprayed aluminium (TSA) 200 micrometres minimum with sealer, per ISO 2063 (or a silicone aluminium alternative above 400 degC)
